reviews.title: Game changing for FPS
reviews.comment:
See bottom for 2 ideas for customization.
Just an epic mouse guys. If you're on the fence, I'd say just go watch some youtube on it. Linus tech tips does a great review and comparison on this mouse. No matter what, at this point a mouse in the "top 10" for competitive gaming have reached a peak. You won't even know the difference from mouse to mouse in this category. Even if a new mouse came out tomorrow and claimed to be LITERALLY 100,000 times faster in EVERY way like polling rate / latency etc... The human eye CAN'T notice the difference at this point. Even on Linus tech tips they showed how they tried to capture the difference on cameras with 1000+ FPS super slow mo and we are talking differences so small the technology we have today couldn't even display it (for the human eye). I'm sure in professional lab grade settings engineers are able to see millionths of seconds worth of delay but if you're here still wondering if this is the mouse for you... Stop. You want this mouse. It looks good. It doesn't have a childish epic dumb gamer look but can do anything you need it to. It's light and you will be amazed at the difference this makes without a wire. You will never be able to go back.
-----
Buy 3rd party mouse feet for this. You won't know you wanted/needed them until you try it. Wow the difference was incredible. This is my first enthusiast mouse and the difference it made putting these feet on was actually equally as substantial as the first time I used this mouse. That incredible feeling. I'm using "hyperslides" and I recommend them. They are under 15 dollars on amazon.
Next, just personal preference- you can pay 100-150 for the charging pad from logitech, or you can pay 10 dollars for a magnetic micro USB charger cable. Plug the little magnet stud into your mouse then you can just push your mouse over to your improvised charging "dock" where the other magnet end of your cable is and go to bed. This ensures you will never have to worry about your charger port wearing out, and if you were like me and kept having to unplug your wireless dongle and risk misplacing it, then this solves that issue too. And lastly and most importantly that frees you up to use large form factor mouse pads which I also recommend. I'm using one that spans the entire surface of my desk which makes my mouse hand feel almost completely free. - Enjoy your mouse guys! (PS, getting this thing refurb + hyperslides + micro USB magnet charger + large form factor mouse pad for <150 dollars compared to brand new 330 dollars mouse + small sized charge pad... lol no brainer)
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: One of the best wireless mice available
reviews.comment:
I used a Glorious Model O Wireless but was tired of the battery life constantly draining after a few days of use so I decided to pick up the G Pro. So far, I'm pleasantly surprised. The clicks are crisp and not a whole lot of smoosh, the scroll wheel feels really good too. My favorite part of it is the battery life. I have used it pretty heavily for about a week now and I'm sitting right around 60% battery. I use it for gaming and work from home. Of course the mouse is going to be a little bit heavier than the Model O Wireless but after an hour of using it, I got used to it. Still just as accurate as I was on the MOW. I keep the RGB off since you can't see it anyways while using it.
As far as the renewed from Amazon, I haven't noticed anything wrong with the mouse since I bought it. Packaging was obviously opened previously, but the contents were there and I did not experience any issues there.
So far, I'd say pick this mouse up if you're looking for a wireless option that doesn't require batteries like the G305 and has a really great battery life.
reviews.author: Daren Moon

reviews.title: Great mouse for gaming
reviews.comment: Long battery life, great ergonomics, easy setup, great range, and lots of configuration options. Comes with four extra buttons in the sides of the mouse. The mouse feels very high quality, with a smooth finish. Make sure you download the Logitech Hub software application so you can customize your DPI and RGB to whatever you want (you can set the RGB lights to every color on the spectrum and add cool effects like color pulsating).

reviews.comment: When I finally had all the stuff for my dream pc there was one thing missing, a mouse. I went looking through tons or review videos and I finally found this one. I highly recommend this mouse to anyone in the market for one!!
